headline: Anthropic's Claude AI aids a Crispr-like enzyme discovery
summary: Anthropic says its Claude AI has autonomously discovered a new enzyme system similar to the machinery behind Crispr, the first result from the company's newly launched wet lab and an early test of Claude's usefulness for science. Humans remain in the loop, and Claude has not been let run the lab unsupervised.
